page.notes: Running head at top right is a dark decorated block; I could not read it. The mark in the left margin looks like handwriting, so I left it out. Long s is printed as f throughout (feruus, fit, eft, caufa, difceptandum); I have written it as s. The catchword "ex" sits at the right below the last line; I kept it out of the text. The printed word "haberiqúe" has an accent over the u; I have written "haberique" without it.
